lead: Concert photograph at night, heavy metal show, crimson and purple stage light, smoke, sweat.
notes: Mood-only mini images for Mosh_Pit_Mayhem.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen Mosh_Pit_Mayhem-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish Mosh_Pit_Mayhem-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: pit
images.prompt: Long-haired metal fans slamming into each other in a mosh pit in front of a stage.

images.name: band
images.prompt: A heavy metal band playing on stage, guitarist headbanging, drummer behind, smoke and red lights.

images.name: medics
images.prompt: Paramedics in a festival medical tent stitching up a grinning long-haired metal fan on a cot.

images.name: song
images.prompt: A circle pit seen from above, fans running in a ring and crashing into each other.

images.name: concert
images.prompt: A packed concert hall at night, a sea of raised horns hands in front of a blazing stage.

images.name: tour
images.prompt: An old tour bus driving down a highway at night toward the lights of a city.

images.name: break
images.prompt: Sweaty metal fans resting against a crowd barrier between songs, drinking water.

images.name: barrier
images.prompt: A steel crowd barrier at the front of a concert, a fan leaping off it into the crowd.

images.name: limbs
images.prompt: A lost leather boot and a studded wristband lying on a dirty concert floor under red light.

images.name: floor
images.prompt: A concrete concert floor covered in dark red stains, dirt smears and footprints after the show.
